description: Find currently searchable service listings in this shared marketplace. Search this shared marketplace for current active INDEXED public listings. Only explicitly published fields are returned; PRIVATE and UNLISTED records are excluded, including from totals. Ranking matches the existing public listing API. Price, inventory, identity, performance and payment are not verified. No account, signing, publication or provider call.

category.description: Optional category filter; it does not broaden access to unlisted or private records.

limit.description: Maximum public results to return in this page; use the advertised bound.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the current public result page.

query.description: Optional words describing the service needed; searches only current public listings.

name: aap_public_listing_search
